title: EcoSwap
tagline: An AI agent-based decentralized carbon verification and trading platform
description:
EcoSwap is a revolutionary carbon credit trading platform that bridges the gap between carbon offset producers (landowners with solar farms/forests) and carbon-intensive enterprises through verified, tradeable digitally immutable carbon coins

Our platform serves three key entities:
Users (Carbon Offseters): Farm/land owners with solar installations or forests who can monetize their carbon-negative activities. They submit verification documents (Aadhaar cards, Renewable Energy Certificates, digitally-signed land ownership deeds) and geotagged photos of their assets. Which is very by AI Agents and ETH foundation's zkPDF.

Enterprises: Carbon-intensive companies seeking verified carbon credits to offset their emissions and meet sustainability goals. They can purchase credits through our marketplace with real-time pricing via Pyth Network oracles.
Auditors: Regulatory compliance bodies with dedicated dashboards to monitor all transactions, ensuring transparency through immutable data storage for security and user convenience.

Key Features:
Zero Knowledge Proof Verification: This uses Ethereum Foundation bounty implementations to create ZKPs for government-issued documents without revealing sensitive data
AI-Powered Asset Verification: Computer vision and VLMs analyze geotagged photos to cross-verify solar panel counts, area coverage, vegetation types, tree age, and carbon sequestration potential
Geographic Verification: Integration with Mapbox and Leaflet.js for location verification and satellite imagery analysis
Batched Transactions: Annual carbon credit accumulation with transaction batching to reduce gas fees
Flow: We are using flow for aggregating small transaction which helps in saving gas fees making gas fees feels negligible

Real-time Pricing: Pyth Network integration for dynamic carbon credit pricing
how_its_made:
EcoSwap: Decentralized AI-Powered Carbon Credit Trading Platform

EcoSwap introduces Carbon Coins, a digitally immutable token that represents verified carbon credits.
These tokens make carbon credits secure, traceable, and easily tradable, ensuring transparency and trust between carbon offset producers and carbon-intensive enterprises.

EcoSwap is designed to bridge the gap between carbon offset producers (such as landowners with solar farms or forests) and carbon-intensive enterprises, enabling seamless verification, trading, and compliance in a decentralized ecosystem.

Key Stakeholders

Users (Carbon Offsetters):
Farm or landowners with solar installations or forested land can monetize their carbon-negative activities.

They upload verification documents such as Aadhaar cards, Renewable Energy Certificates, and digitally signed land ownership deeds.

They also submit geotagged photos of their assets.

Verification is handled by AI agents and Ethereum Foundation’s zkPDF technology, ensuring data privacy and authenticity.

Enterprises (Carbon Credit Buyers):
Carbon-intensive companies looking to offset emissions and achieve sustainability targets can purchase verified Carbon Coins directly through the marketplace.

Real-time pricing is powered by Pyth Network oracles, ensuring transparent and dynamic market rates.

Auditors (Regulatory Authorities):
Compliance bodies access dedicated dashboards to track transactions and ensure regulatory compliance.

All data is stored immutably on-chain, providing full transparency and security.

Core Features

Carbon Coin Integration
Every verified carbon credit is issued as a Carbon Coin, ensuring that all credits are tamper-proof, traceable, and easy to trade across the platform.

Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) Verification
Uses Ethereum Foundation bounty implementations to verify government-issued documents without exposing sensitive personal data.

AI-Powered Asset Verification
Leverages computer vision and vision-language models (VLMs) to analyze geotagged photos and validate:

Solar panel counts and coverage

Vegetation density and tree age

Carbon sequestration potential

Geographic Verification
Integrates Mapbox and Leaflet.js for location validation and satellite imagery analysis, ensuring submitted assets are genuine.

Batched Transactions with Flow

Annual carbon credit accumulation is batched into single transactions, dramatically reducing gas fees.

Flow integration ensures near-negligible transaction costs, making the platform highly scalable.

Real-Time Pricing
Pyth Network integration provides live carbon credit prices, ensuring fair, transparent, and market-driven rates.
